payload.author: framework-coordinator
evidence: CheckBox 0x0060F0E9 tests current_ before the sole current_entry call at F0F2; F10D/F153/F48F test Dialog+C4, which is item_list_.head_ at StringStruct+8. The mapped current_entry implementation at 0x00402530 also guards head_, not its returned payload. Guards on current_ and payload introduce different behavior.

CheckBox F4CE calls strchr on head-guarded text; F4DC-F4F9 reloads head/current/payload/text afterwards, and F52E-F54B reloads after splitting the string. The multiline tail F631-F6FA repeats those access patterns and allows null to reach strchr/wrap. RadioButton DB98 onward and DD3A-DE03 carry the coupled pattern. This supports investigation of reusable accessors but does not establish their original names, separate function identities, or current acceptance.
payload.hypothesis: The repeated head-guarded payload/text reads in both draw methods suggest missing inline StringList accessors, not interchangeable head/current/payload null checks. Preserve the actual reads during restoration; investigate shared accessor ownership and names before expanding to stringstruct.h or treating duplicated expressions as the final class API.
